स्कंद् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (स्कंदति, स्कन्न) 1 To leap, jump. --2 To rise, ascend, jump upwards. --3 To fall, drop; Bk. 22. 11. --4 To burst or leap out. --5 To perish, come to an end; चस्कंदे तप ऐश्वरम्. --6 To be spilled, ooze. --7 To emit, shed. --8 To go, move. --9 To become dry. --10 To perish. --Caus. (स्कंदयति-ते) To collect.
